title: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools for agents
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented controls and feature-specific gaps are supported. The updated MCP management guidance warrants narrower wording: registry blocking and tool toggles govern supported Agent 365 pathways, not direct access to underlying APIs. Minor corrections also concern the product-level consumption licensing model and the Registry step in two paths; all cited pages opened successfully.
